Step 3. Applying the differentiable interpolation theorem to \(U_{01330013}\), we obtain the norm bound in the mixed Lebesgue scale for the appropriate exponents.

Conclusion. Steps 1-3 yield the result via linear interpolation and the uniqueness of the decomposition.
